groups.name: navigation
checks: goto/forward/waitForUrl navigate the hosted page
back/reload/pushState preserve native page ownership
Navigation retains the native-instance marker

groups.name: form-controls
checks: Checkboxes and native select controls retain their requested values
focus/type/hover/dblclick reach the intended DOM controls

groups.name: pointer-scroll
checks: CSS coordinate clickAt uses the hosted viewport correctly
Drag dispatch reaches the fixture drop target
scrollIntoView and scroll/wheel operate the page viewport

groups.name: javascript-init
checks: Async page evaluate and tab.run Puppeteer facade return structured results
Document-start scripts install, survive reload and can be removed

groups.name: storage
checks: Cookies can be set and read in the isolated CEF profile
Local and session storage can be written and read
Same-profile tabs intentionally share same-origin local storage
Storage state exports and restores the current origin

groups.name: network
checks: Requests, headers and response-body diagnostics capture real fetch traffic
HAR output contains the fixture network request
Persistent routes fulfill and abort requests, then unregister
tab.run response wait observes the actual HTTP response

groups.name: upload
checks: uploadFile installs the actual local file into the CEF file input
The page uploads the exact file contents to the isolated server

groups.name: diagnostics
checks: Console logs and JavaScript errors are captured
DOM and lifecycle metrics are available
Tracing produces DevTools timeline events
CPU profiling produces a CDP profile artifact

groups.name: emulation
checks: Viewport, media preferences and timezone emulation apply
User agent, HTTP headers and offline simulation work
Emulation remains scoped to A and known device profiles are listed

groups.name: feature-detection
checks: Optional WebMCP/React discovery returns structured results on a non-React page

groups.name: download
checks: Download events report the completed CEF download
The downloaded file is complete and stays inside this acceptance run

groups.name: capture-pdf
checks: Element screenshots detect real page changes and suppress unchanged output
CEF Page.printToPDF produces a valid PDF artifact
Annotated screenshots have observable element targets

groups.name: dialogs
groups.error: Error: ToolError: tab.click("#confirm") timed out after 8000ms; could not count matches: no answer within 1000ms
groups.cleanup: Native control quit and SIGTERM did not complete within 15s + 5s. Driver cleanup raised TimeoutExpired; a later process check confirmed the owned PID exited. No clean shutdown claim.

groups.name: selectors
checks: ARIA refs and open Shadow DOM handles work
XPath, test-id and semantic-role selectors resolve correctly
Visibility, enabled state, geometry and computed-style reads work
Text/HTML/Markdown extraction reads the embedded document
CDP accessibility observation exposes numeric element handles

groups.name: frames
checks: Same-origin and cross-site frames exist with genuine DOM origin separation
OMP frame-scoped click/fill/text work across origins
Cross-origin frame ARIA snapshots expose its controls
Frame and owner-element screenshot artifacts are emitted; crop correctness requires visual acceptance
